# v2.3.1

This maintenance release updates the docs and contributor toolchain. MCP runtime features and dependencies are unchanged from v2.3.0.

## Changes

- Removed unused `archiver` development packages and updated `tsx`.
- Updated the docs toolchain to patched Vite and KaTeX versions. Mermaid diagrams continue to render in docs builds and the local docs dev server.
- Added the docs build to Node 20 CI. The full `npm audit` reports zero vulnerabilities at release.

Install with `npm install -g @joeytheman/gemini-mcp-tool@2.3.1`, or run it with `npx -y @joeytheman/gemini-mcp-tool@2.3.1`.
